title: Dataset of intracranial EEG during cortical stimulations evoking negative motor responses
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 23 patients undergoing stereo-EEG presurgical evaluation for drug-resistant epilepsy, capturing 41 instances of high-frequency cortical stimulation that evoked negative motor responses. Each recording includes pre- and post-stimulation epochs used for connectivity analysis, along with detailed stimulation parameters. The dataset supports research into the cortical networks underlying negative motor phenomena elicited by direct electrical stimulation.
methods_description: iEEG data were recorded around 41 high-frequency bipolar cortical stimulations (biphasic pulses, 1 ms duration, 43.2 Hz alternating or 50 Hz non-alternating, 0.25-3 mA, up to 5 s) that evoked negative motor responses. Each recording spans 24 seconds, including 9-10 seconds pre- and post-stimulation, with two 5-second epochs (pre- and post-stimulation) used for baseline and connectivity analysis. Stimulation contact pairs, current intensity, and evoked effects are documented in the events files.
